identity.title: Finite Discovery-to-Decision-to-Research-Paper Evidence Proof
identity.objective: Prove native discovery-to-offline-Hermes-decision-to-research-paper evidence composition with complete denominators and strict lineage in one bounded foreground no-network proof, implementing only the demonstrated missing finite manifest/adapter; no provider calls or trade authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Remove only the six named committed files; retain all native ALPHA-02, Alpha, WP173, AUTO-01/02/OAuth, lifecycle and Hermes manager code unchanged. Local scratch fixture/manifest state remains noncanonical and separately operator-controlled.

api_matrix.reason: One additive foreground tool and sanitized evidence contract. Existing native contracts, formats and APIs remain unchanged.

items.surface: Foreground proof CLI with explicit scratch and input
items.before: No single finite operator proof and cold-verifiable decision-denominator output.
items.after: Operator supplies an explicit bounded case and scratch destination; prepare/run/verify are finite, deterministic and offline.
items.compatibility_requirement: No default paths, implicit real calls, daemon, schedule, repo canonical writes or changes to native contracts. A no-code proof may legitimately stop if APIs already compose or prerequisites are absent.

items.surface: Canonical discovery / Alpha / lifecycle / Hermes fake / WP173 APIs
items.before: Existing validators, schemas, registries, AUTO-02 FakeHermesBackend and paper snapshot own their domains.
items.after: Call and verify the same public APIs without copying engines or writing their source; do not infer strategy from market.
items.compatibility_requirement: All real/project stores read-only; only explicitly synthetic research-paper and fake manager scratch stores may be written. Keep historical/current scope distinct.

items.before: No cross-system cold-verifiable manifest of attempted, rejected, abstained and attributed vs unlinked feedback.
items.after: One explicit scratch-root manifest with bound source refs, all attempts and exact closed terminal classification, plus deterministic verify mode.
items.compatibility_requirement: No raw prompts, tokens, private positions, account ids, full local paths or personal data in export; replay is verification, never second inference.

items.condition: Native RUNTIME prompt/spec/readiness passes on exact six-path frozen scope and fully simulated changed-path/allowlist guards, with no unresolved source contradictions.

Karl expressly authorizes this exact offline finite feasibility proof, isolated local scratch and conditional minimum six-file implementation/publication; never authorizes provider/model/network/trading.

Mandatory no-code feasibility probe first. If needed and possible with only six paths, bounded foreground adapter plus 7 concrete tests, cold evidence and stable-head full suite; otherwise clean truthful NOT_NEEDED/BLOCKED stop without commit or PR.

failure_precedence.reason: Use unchanged repository-native readiness-failure order; runtime decision failures are sanitized, local-only and never provide authority.

examples.reason: No new domain validation schema introduced; seven named focused negative-control tests cover required semantics and adversarial cases.

evidence_plan.reason: Seven observable requirements mapped to named isolated tests, plus native readiness, security guard, changed-path regressions and one stable-head full suite.

items.expected_result: Cold verified observed PIT and native ALPHA-02 queue preserve universe denominator, all disposition counts and UNKNOWN coverage; no external completeness claim.
No guessed market/condition/token/candidate/version/assessment linkage, <=8 unique deterministic menu, and explicit unmatched/overflow status.
Persist STARTED first; one occurrence one terminal or interrupted, NO_TRADE/PAUSE/REASSESS separate; replay no new occurrence and no extra provider calls.
Only cold native WP173 research paper store, exact binding/head/window, separate fills/orders, cumulative/delta, missing mark/no-fill/loss preservation.
Only eligible preview with exact candidate/version/lifecycle head/manager store; FakeHermesBackend clearly labelled; stale/future outcomes and NO_TRADE cannot get attributed paper credit.
Corrupt/missing stores, historical/current confusion, duplicate paths/ids, private material, forbidden provider/network/live operations fail closed without mutation of source stores.
Exact replay from immutable manifest and frozen inputs yields identical digest and denominations; tamper/unknown outcome impossible, 3 classifications and no secrets.

successor_boundary.next_title: Separately Authorized Bounded Recurring Autonomous Discovery And Research Campaigns
forbidden_in_this_wp: Any real OAuth/Codex/ChatGPT/Firecrawl inference or model-list/credential access, OpenAI API keys, account data or purchased credits, including reuse of consumed PR243 call.
Any external Gamma/CLOB/product-market HTTP, internet research, new data ingestion, live venue state, hosted platform or SSH/VPS access.
Any automatic recurring campaign, scheduler, Prefect service, background daemon, multi-user host, persistent polling or retries creating extra attempts.
Any paper intent or order created from a Hermes choice, real order, wallet/account operation, signing, money movement, capital or risk/portfolio change.
Any claim of ex ante alpha, prospective OOS performance, causal paper profit, whole-market completeness, strategy qualification or Gate C eligibility.
Any native code edit under src/, dependency/workflow change, tests waived for scope bypass, extra path, hidden canonical registry mutation or user-unauthorized merge.
